# PiTTy 0.6.50

## Status bar fixes

- Extension status text no longer leaks raw ANSI codes into the status bar. The MCP adapter colors its footer status, and those escape sequences used to render literally while also corrupting the footer's width math. Status text is now cleaned, single-line, and bounded.
- Footer overflow clips instead of painting segments over each other — no more `ginclaude` or `2dc2h` mashups.
- Key hints now step down before usage summaries are dropped, so the Codex tracker stays visible at widths that used to shed it. If Codex is still missing with no failure in the diagnostics log, the row was full (widen the terminal); if `~/.pi/agent/auth.json` has no `openai-codex` OAuth entry, the segment hides until the next login.
- cswap accounts whose live usage needs a relogin now show the last fetched usage marked `·stale <age>` (e.g. `claude(work) 61%·4d18h·stale 3h37m`) instead of a false `claude login expired`. Genuinely unavailable usage reads as `claude usage unavailable`. The model itself keeps working through Pi's own credentials either way.

## Model list sync

- `Ctrl+P` opens immediately — even on a slow Pi — and syncs visibly: `syncing with Pi…` while refreshing, `sync failed — showing cached list` when Pi is unreachable.
- Compaction and subagent model pickers always fetch a fresh list instead of trusting the cache.
- Thinking pickers no longer offer `off` for models that explicitly exclude it.
- Context windows are Pi's per-provider numbers: `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` reports 272k while the Codex entry reports 500k. PiTTy shows them as reported rather than guessing; pick the provider entry with the window you need.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.50` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
